Running Python code interactively: import struct
data = open('/tmp/testcase.exr','rb').read()
# compression value
comp = data[89]
print("compression:", comp)  # 9 = DWA? Let me check. Actually compression enum: 0 none,1 rle,2 zips,3 zip,4 piz,5 pxr24,6 b44,7 b44a,8 dwaa,9 dwab
# channels chlist at offset 57 (after name+type+size). Let me parse
# chlist: sequence of channels, each: name\0, pixeltype(4), pLinear(1), reserved(3), xSampling(4), ySampling(4), then \0 terminator
off = 57
chans = []
while True:
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    cname = data[off:end].decode()
    off = end+1
    if cname == '':
        break
    ptype, plinear, xsam, ysam = struct.unpack('<iB3xi i'.replace(' ',''), data[off:off+16])
    # actually: <i (4) B (1) 3x (3) i (4) i (4) = 16
    ptype = struct.unpack('<i', data[off:off+4])[0]
    plinear = data[off+4]
    xsam = struct.unpack('<i', data[off+8:off+12])[0]
    ysam = struct.unpack('<i', data[off+12:off+16])[0]
    off += 16
    chans.append((cname, ptype, plinear, xsam, ysam))
    print("chan:", cname, ptype, plinear, xsam, ysam)
print("chans:", chans)
print("offset after chlist:", off)
# after channels attr, next attr
# data window etc
print("remaining bytes from off:", data[off:].hex())
